findings.title: REIMAGINE 2 — CagriSema vs semaglutide 2.4 mg and 1.0 mg in T2D, phase 3
findings.whatChanged: Semaglutide is the active comparator; new head-to-head data vs a combination product. Dossier lacks it. DOI 10.1016/S2213-8587(26)00125-7, NCT06065540.

findings.title: Oral Semaglutide 25 mg Versus Orforglipron 36 mg in Obesity: A Population-Adjusted Indirect Treatment Comparison (Diabetes Obes Metab)
findings.whatChanged: First formal oral-semaglutide-vs-orforglipron comparison (OASIS 4 vs ATTAIN-1). Reports BOTH estimands: -3.2 points treatment-regimen, -3.0 points efficacy, favouring oral semaglutide. Directly relevant to the site comparison pages. Sponsor-aligned indirect comparison — label as such.

findings.title: Benefits and Harms of Pharmacologic Treatments in Adults With Overweight or Obesity: Living Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis for the American College of Physicians (Ann Intern Med)
findings.whatChanged: ACP-commissioned living NMA, 69 studies / 112,511 participants: semaglutide and tirzepatide give the greatest weight loss; semaglutide "probably" reduces mortality and MACE. A guideline-grade citation the dossier does not have. DOI 10.7326/ANNALS-24-03764.
